Ahmedabad Firecracker Factory Blast Kills Eight

A firecracker factory in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, experienced a significant blast resulting in the deaths of at least eight people and injuring several others. Reports indicate the unit was allegedly operating without a valid license, with some sources stating its license had expired or been cancelled. Authorities have reportedly detained individuals in connection with the incident.
